overall: Batch J2 checked against the disassembly of both firmwares. 26 functions: 25 CONFIRMED, 1 AMENDED (0x22070: plate comment only). All 14 twins re-derived instruction by instruction (0x2142c, 0x216c6, 0x21778, 0x21872, 0x21f4e, 0x21fac, 0x22070, 0x23216, 0x21642, 0x2167e, 0x21714, 0x142a8, 0x23820, 0x239d2). For each, the CM848 row takes the same unprefixed name, and the CM848 function_definitions / local_variables rows keyed by the old cm848_ names must follow (8 of the 14 have rows). 0x238ac stays a counterpart: its code equals CM848 0x53d3c except the capacity 5 against 10. 67 globals: 60 CONFIRMED, 6 AMENDED, 1 REFUTED. The amended names (0x80da58, 0x80da8c, 0x80198e, 0x801990, 0x808184) drop etc1_ / pgn61442_, because in CM550 the J1922 command handler 0x1f4e8 and the J1708 message handler 0x1f84e drive the same flags, so they take neutral names like their siblings high_idle_override_active_flag and driveline_disengaged_flag. 0x80da86 keeps its name with a corrected comment (J1922 loader). 0x80da90 is REFUTED: it is only ever cleared. The new structs are proven from every access: j1939_control_session_t 24, j1939_periodic_transmit_entry_t 10, engine_tsc1_ignored_request_t 8 and retarder_tsc1_ignored_request_t 4 (definitions in the investigator result_full.json note 4). The apply step must remove the swallowed rows 0x8041fc, 0x804216 and 0x801998-0x8019b8, which are fields of those records. The 6 J1939_DIAGNOSTIC_SERVICE members are CONFIRMED. The 11 new-enum members (TSC1_OVERRIDE_MODE / J1939_CONTROL_DEVICE / CONTROL_NETWORK) are only in result_full.json, not in the proposal, and were not judged. skipped[] is empty, so there is nothing to keep skipped. The ROM 'table' 0x1b4da-0x1b4e9 is code: the operands of the first three jsr (abs).l of the 10 ms task set 0x1b4d8 (live name cm550_runEvery2FramesTaskSetPhase0). No code walks it. executiveFrameInterruptHandler calls 0x1b4d8 with bsr.w at 20 frame sites (0x1b960-0x1be4c) and the odd set 0x1b504 (live ...Phase1: 0x2142c, 0x1ff38, 0x23920) at 20 others. CM848 runs the same order from cm848_phase_group_a_processing. Leads: FUN_0001fe84 has no row; mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink reaches it through movea.l #0x1fe84,a4 (operand 0x28b8c), and it is the counterpart of cm848_scheduleJ1939PeriodicMessage. 0x801d44 / 0x801d48 (tsc1_message_*) are the ETC1 bytes of 0x2efd0. _cal: the monitor cells 0x804164-0x804233 are EEPROM-backed (EEPROM 0x65A-0x729) but lie past the stated window end 0x804155, so they carry no _cal. Whether the window is longer is still open.

verdicts.own_role: J1939 periodic transmit scheduler (second call of the odd 10 ms task set 0x1b504): with J1939 enabled it walks queue 0 (0x80096e, count 0x800a9a) on broadcast bit 2 and queue 1 (0x800a36, count 0x800a9b) on bit 3, calls each entry whose next tick equals the queue tick, adds its period, then advances the tick.

verdicts.reason: Decompile and asm agree; CM848 0x538ef4 adds the DM13 hook, a TBL budget of 9 and TouCAN IMASK writes -> counterpart. It reads CTM4 0xfff404 and writes the chip-select 82527, so mc68k_ is the right prefix. Reached only by jsr at 0x1b4d8 (operand 0x1b4da).

verdicts.final_comment: J1939 monitor (algorithm_enable_flags_2_cal.j1939_monitor_enable, e2m JC39MREA), third call of the even frame task set 0x1b4d8. Engine half (control mode 0x80da50, network type 0x80da68, source address 0x80da70 against the copies 0x800b12 / 0x800b16 / 0x800b18): a non-zero mode on network 1 opens a session record (startJ1939ControlSession) when none is open; a new mode from the same source is appended to the record's five mode words (shifted when full); a new source stores the duration, files the record (storeJ1939ControlSessionInHistoryTable) and opens a new one; mode 0 after a network 1 control clears the control status 0x80422a, stores the duration and files the record; a control on another network after network 1 clears the status and files the record without a duration. The retarder half does the same for retarder_control_mode and the source address word 0x80d9e8 (copies 0x800b14 / 0x800b19, status 0x80422c, record 0x804212) with no network test. Twin of CM848 0x50bff4.
